articles.title: Lakhimpur Kheri police secure fifty convictions in crimes against women
articles.summary: During 2026, police in Lakhimpur Kheri secured convictions in more than fifty cases of crimes against women and girls. Authorities also traced and reunited eleven hundred forty five missing females with their families. These actions occurred under the Uttar Pradesh government campaigns known as Mission Shakti and Operation Conviction, which aim to improve public safety and deliver justice.

articles.title: Arunachal Pro Boxing Season 4 ends with CM’s pledge for a new stadium
articles.summary: The centrepiece of Season 4 was a gruelling 10-round contest between Poken Siga of Arunachal Pradesh and Vanlalawmpuia of Mizoram. articles.title: Indian government and opposition clash over street protests and regime change
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh accused opposition leaders of attempting to topple an elected government through street agitations. The Bharatiya Janata Party claimed the opposition was importing foreign models of unrest. Meanwhile, the Congress party defended street protests as a fundamental democratic right. The ongoing standoff highlights a growing national debate over the legitimate methods of achieving political change.

articles.title: Congress Defends Regime Change Calls Amid Electoral Roll Protests
articles.summary: The Indian National Congress defended calls for regime change in New Delhi on Saturday, October 17, stating that replacing an elected government through elections is a democratic right. Senior leaders argued against Bharatiya Janata Party criticism following protests over electoral roll revisions. Meanwhile, the Supreme Court is reviewing petitions concerning transparency and political demonstrations.

articles.title: Allahabad High Court Orders Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Polls In Three Months
articles.summary: The Allahabad High Court ordered the Uttar Pradesh government to complete three-tier panchayat elections within three months. The court also upheld the appointment of outgoing administrators.

articles.title: North, central India to go dry as rain turns focus to the South

articles.title: A Big Company’s Payment Date Is A Small Company’s Payroll Date
articles.summary: The owner may need to borrow, use personal savings or postpone purchases to keep operations running, says Souradeep Ganguly. articles.summary: Star composer Anirudh Ravichander who is basking in the success of Rajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’ will be getting married to Kavya Maran daughter of Indian billionaire media proprietor Kalanithi Maran. articles.title: Bihar Police To Digitally Map Boundaries Of Every Police Station, Track Crime Hotspots
articles.summary: Patna : Bihar Police is developing a Geographic Information System (GIS)-based portal to digitally map the boundaries of police stations across the state , aiming to reduce jurisdiction disputes and improve coordination during investigations and emergency responses. articles.title: Rare Apple-1 computer with letter from Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak signature sells
articles.summary: An exceptionally rare, fully operational Apple-1 computer has sold at auction for $1. 15 million – setting a new world-record price for a commercially released model of the machine that started Apple. articles.title_hi: स्टीव जॉब्स के पत्र, स्टीव वोज्नियाक के हस्ताक्षर वाला दुर्लभ Apple-1 कंप्यूटर बिकता है

articles.title_hinglish: stiva jobsa ke patr, stiva vojniyaka ke hastakshara vala durlabha Apple-1 kanpyutara bikata hai
articles.summary_hinglish: eka asadharana durlabh, puri taraha se chalu hone vala Apple-1 kanpyutara nilami men $1 men bika hai। 15 miliyana - Apple dvara shuru ki gaee mashina ke vyavasayika rupa se jari modala ke lie eka naya vishva-rikorda mulya sthapita karana। bikri do sangrahakon ke bicha 28 minata ki gahana boli ladaाee ke bada sanpanna huee, jisamen pisi ne aippala ki 50vin varshagantha varsha ke daurana nilami bloka ko para kara liya।

articles.title: Kapil Sibal criticizes government over denotification of Jantar Mantar

articles.title: Fake Google Chrome app with over 1 lakh downloads found on Google Play: How
articles.summary: A fake version of the Google Chrome browser appeared on the official Google Play Store, displaying over 1 lakh (100,000) downloads and securing a paid “sponsored” placement directly above Google’s genuine browser. articles.title: Indian Politics is Shifting as Public Perspective on Rahul Gandhi Changes
